title: NativeAOT-Compatible RunFrame Hot Path
body: RunFrame hot-path implementation must remain compatible with NativeAOT constraints: no new reflection, expression trees, dynamic code generation, or LINQ allocations on the hot call graph.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Performance optimizations introduce no reflection, expression trees, or dynamic code generation in the RunFrame call graph.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Code review of PR #3 optimized BasicBus and VideoRenderer with direct/static paths only

acceptanceCriteria.text: Performance optimizations avoid LINQ and closure allocation in the measured RunFrame hot path.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: PR #3 uses loops and span fills in hot path; RunFramePerfProbe reports allocated=0 bytes
